modules.adaptation: Reimplemented the template library and visual composition workflow against FazeMES JSON versions and whitelisted datasets. UReport XML, scripts and arbitrary SQL execution are not imported.

Native Spring/Vue document ingestion, published-document BM25 retrieval, source citations, private sessions and configurable OpenAI-compatible/Ollama generation. Qdrant and local transformer models are not bundled.

modules.reference: frontend/web-admin client portal and backend /api/client endpoints
modules.adaptation: Customer accounts bind to actual FazeMES clients; separate sessions, explicit published product catalog, ordering requests with review and scoped production progress replace fixed-customer sample data.
Loopback SFace worker, YuNet landmark alignment and self-enrollment protected by the current password. Features are encrypted per tenant/user; no upstream personal face photographs are copied.
